business.description: India Lease Development Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) focused on recovery of old dues and deployment of funds to earn returns on investments. The company did not satisfy the principal business criteria under Section 45-I(f) of the RBI Act, 1934 during part of FY 2025-26 and as at March 31, 2026, as financial assets were less than 50% of total assets.
end_markets: small and medium enterprises in the rural and semi-urban area

products.note: Single primary business and only reportable segment

outlook.statement: Recovery of the old dues has been the main focus of the company and the management is confident that with the maximum recovery, it would be possible to deploy the funds to earn a better return on investments.
The company is consolidating its position and making its best efforts to realize the maximum from the customers by taking recourse of legal remedies where warranted.

The Company continues to explore viable business opportunities while ensuring compliance with RBI and other statutory requirements. The Company expects improvement in its financial performance upon commencement of suitable business activities and optimization of its investment portfolio.

Investment Risk: Plan liability funded and return on plan assets below discount rate creates plan deficit
Interest Risk: Decrease in bond interest rate (discount rate) increases plan liability
Mortality Risk: Change in mortality rate affects plan liability

Price Risk: Exposure to equity shares & mutual funds price fluctuations
Interest Rate Risk: Exposure to term deposits and long-term debt obligations with floating rates
Credit Risk: Counterparty default risk from trade receivables, deposits with banks, and investments
Liquidity Risk: Risk of meeting obligations associated with financial liabilities
Regulatory Risk: Non-compliance with RBI requirement to maintain 50% of total assets in financial assets
